title: Credential setup through masked pop-up dialogs into the OS keyring
summary: Operator asked (2026-09-29) which credentials Model Infrastructure needs and to save them locally with Windows pop-ups. secret_prompt.py lists the known credentials with purpose, minimal scope and source: secrets://runpod/default (read-only key until provisioning is approved; public pricing works without it), secrets://huggingface/default (Read token; optional, radar now sends it when configured), secrets://local-abliterated/default (only if the operator's model server needs a key). `orchestrate secrets setup` shows one masked tkinter dialog per credential (topmost), stores non-empty values via secret_refs.store (Windows Credential Manager, entries agent-os/<provider>/<profile>), skips blank/Cancel and already-configured refs unless --reprompt, and reports presence/source only. `secrets set <ref> --gui` does one ref; `secrets status` with no ref lists all known refs. No payment data enters Agent OS.
